mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE > 5.0% are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and housing starts (HOUST > 1000) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in instances where INDPRO > 100 AND HOUST > 1000 are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% (FEDFUNDS > 1.0) signals a monetary tightening cycle, increasing the risk-free rate and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS > 1.0 are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher residential fixed investment (RSAFS) value is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods with RSAFS above the 50th percentile of its 3-year historical distribution are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 units (thousands), it signals a contraction in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in instances where HOUST < 1000 are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a strong labor market (PAYEMS > 140000) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals robust economic growth without immediate monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in instances where PAYEMS > 140000 AND FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven growth regime (INDPRO > 100), industrial production growth signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in the supply-driven growth regime (INDPRO > 100) are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
